What We Do

Two sides of the same careful crew

Whether it's one room or one hundred, the standard doesn't change — just the scale.

Residential

Interiors, exteriors, cabinetry, and everything in between — finished with the care of a homeowner and the schedule of a professional crew.

Commercial

Tenant improvements, multi-unit turns, and ground-up builds. We work on GC timelines and leave walkthroughs clean the first time.

Why Proper Paint Specialists

Painting is a finishing trade. We treat it like one.

Our background spans production arts, formal commercial design training, and hands-on construction experience — which means we read a punch list the way a general contractor does, and a color palette the way a designer does.

That combination is why we're brought in as a contractor partner, not just hired as a sub. We understand schedules, sequencing, and the standard a finished space needs to meet before anyone signs off on it.

Design-Trained

Formal commercial design background informs every color and finish recommendation.

Construction-Minded

Experience on commercial construction sites means we work in step with your schedule, not against it.

Detail-Driven

A production arts background means precision and presentation are never an afterthought.
